description: This file contains unit tests for the AccessTokenRepository class in the OAuth module of the OrangeHRM system. It tests methods related to creation, persistence, revocation, and retrieval of OAuth access tokens, using PHPUnit framework and mock objects.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepositoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the AccessTokenRepository, testing token creation, persistence, revocation, and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, populates test data, and sets up the repository instance with encryption key.

methods.name: testGetNewToken
methods.description: Tests creation of a new access token with minimal data and verifies its serialization.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenWithScopes
methods.description: Tests creation of a new access token with specific scopes.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenAndCallGetExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Checks behavior when calling getExpiryDateTime before it is initialized, expecting an Error.

methods.name: testGetNewTokenAndCallGetIdentifier
methods.description: Checks behavior when calling getIdentifier before it is initialized, expecting an Error.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Tests persisting a new access token to the database and verifies stored values.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessTokenWithExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures exception is thrown when trying to persist a token with a duplicate identifier.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessToken
methods.description: Tests revoking an existing access token and verifies its revoked status.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessTokenWhichAlreadyRevoked
methods.description: Verifies that revoking an already revoked token does not alter its state.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Tests revoking a non-existing token, expecting silent failure.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Verifies that the repository correctly reports the revoked status of tokens.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevokedForNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Checks that non-existent tokens are reported as not revoked.

methods.name: testGetAccessToken
methods.description: Tests retrieval of existing access tokens by token string and handling of invalid token.
